story_text: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session is ended securely.

positive.title: Log out successfully from an active session
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

positive.title: Log out from multiple devices simultaneously
steps: 1. Log in to the account on Device A with valid email and password.
2. Log in to the same account on Device B with valid email and password.
3. Click the 'Logout' button on Device A.
positive.expected_result: User is logged out from Device A but remains logged in on Device B.

positive.title: Log out and ensure session token invalidated
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
3. Attempt to access a protected page (e.g., dashboard) after logging out.
positive.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page when trying to access the protected page after logging out.

positive.title: Log out and verify the redirection to the login page
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

positive.title: Log out and login again with the same credentials
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
3. Log in again with the same email and password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in again with the same credentials.
